integrationNotes: Surveys & microtasks is the purest ₦0 entry point. Priority platforms for Nigerians in 2026: GoJelly (naira direct), Toloka, SproutGigs/Picoworkers-style, ySense, TimeBucks, Remotasks (USD via Payoneer), Prolific (when available). Always verify current acceptance of Nigerian accounts and payout methods before recommending. Channels mix Nigerian practical creators with global skill-upgrade content so users treat this as a bridge, not a career.
